tagline: Rich text in widget titles and descriptions: Visualization widget titles and descriptions now support rich text formatting.
what_it_does: Rich text in widget titles and descriptions: Visualization widget titles and descriptions now support rich text formatting. Click a widget's title or description to open a formatting toolbar, where you can apply text styling, links, and tables, or enter Markdown text directly. Hide pivot table column headers: Dashboard authors can now hide the column header in a pivot table.
why_it_matters: Scheduling dashboard updates ensures that your dashboards display up to date information and improves performance for end users.
